title: pneumaticConveyor operation
description: Dilute-phase pneumatic conveying line: pressure drop of a gas-solids flow along a pipe with bends, from the gas friction plus the solids' acceleration, wall friction and lift. The solids enter as a real stream; the geometry declares the line and its bends, each bend typed because a blinded tee and a long-radius elbow do not cost the same.

geometry.title: Line geometry
geometry.description: The pipe run: diameter, length, vertical rise and the bend list.

dz.title: Vertical rise
dz.description: Signed elevation change; lifting solids costs pressure.

bends.title: Bends
bends.description: `( { type longRadius; } { type blindTee; } { type shortRadius; exitRatio ...; } ... )` — each bend by its kind; the engine reads `type` and `exitRatio` only and refuses any other key by name.

type.title: Bend kind
type.description: longRadius (default), shortRadius or blindTee; any other word is refused.

particleWallFriction.title: Particle-wall friction factor
particleWallFriction.description: Particle-wall Coulomb friction coefficient of the slip force balance; 0.4 when not declared, and the run then announces it as an assumed default.
